suite.name: 零售样例题集
suite.description: 配 tests/fixtures/acceptance/retail.py 的虚构零售库（数据源名 retail_demo）：支付日归属、退款、取消、华南高于华东几个口径陷阱，一道期望答「没有数据」的题，一道问法含糊、期望反问的题。用于演示、验收和真实模型回归；店名、金额都是虚构的

cases.question: 上周（{{ schedule.last_week_start }} 至 {{ schedule.last_week_end }}）的销售额是多少？

gold.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS 销售额 FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' AND paid_date BETWEEN '{{ schedule.last_week_start }}' AND '{{ schedule.last_week_end }}'

expectations.label: 上周销售额（按支付日归属、不含退款和取消）

cases.question: 上周（{{ schedule.last_week_start }} 至 {{ schedule.last_week_end }}）有多少单退款？退款金额是多少？

gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 退款单数, SUM(amount) AS 退款金额 FROM orders WHERE status = 'refunded' AND paid_date BETWEEN '{{ schedule.last_week_start }}' AND '{{ schedule.last_week_end }}'

cases.question: 上周（{{ schedule.last_week_start }} 至 {{ schedule.last_week_end }}）下单后取消的订单有多少单？

gold.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 取消单数 FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' AND order_date BETWEEN '{{ schedule.last_week_start }}' AND '{{ schedule.last_week_end }}'

expectations.label: 上周取消的订单数（按下单日）

cases.question: 上周（{{ schedule.last_week_start }} 至 {{ schedule.last_week_end }}）华南和华东的销售额各是多少？哪个地区更高？

gold.sql: SELECT s.region AS 地区, SUM(o.amount) AS 销售额 FROM orders o JOIN stores s ON s.id = o.store_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND o.paid_date BETWEEN '{{ schedule.last_week_start }}' AND '{{ schedule.last_week_end }}' AND s.region IN ('华南', '华东') GROUP BY s.region ORDER BY 销售额 DESC

expectations.label: 华南、华东上周的销售额，按销售额从高到低

cases.question: 上周（{{ schedule.last_week_start }} 至 {{ schedule.last_week_end }}）华中区的销售额是多少？

gold.sql: SELECT s.region AS 地区, SUM(o.amount) AS 销售额 FROM orders o JOIN stores s ON s.id = o.store_id WHERE s.region = '华中' AND o.status = 'paid' AND o.paid_date BETWEEN '{{ schedule.last_week_start }}' AND '{{ schedule.last_week_end }}' GROUP BY s.region

expectations.label: 没有华中区的门店，应答「没有数据」，不给数
问法含糊（哪段时间、哪个指标都没说），应先反问
